title: Flags in a byte
description:
Store eight on/off settings in one `uint8_t`.

```
settings: 00000000
turn on SOUND and MUSIC: 00000011
toggle FULLSCREEN:       00000111
turn off SOUND:          00000110
MUSIC is on: yes
```
hints: Print from bit 7 down to bit 0: `putchar((v >> i) & 1 ? '1' : '0');` (lesson 5.01).
stretch: Save the settings to a file as one byte and read them back.
